case_record.diagnostic_criteria: DKA is present when glucose is >200 mg/dL, venous pH is <7.30 or bicarbonate is <18 mmol/L, and urine ketones are moderate or large. For this stated rule, beta-hydroxybutyrate is recorded for context but is not used to determine the ketone criterion.
case_record.severity_criteria: Grade severity using venous pH only: mild 7.20-7.29, moderate 7.10-7.19, and severe <7.10.

criterion_checks.rationale: Both recorded acid-base measurements meet the stated acidosis criterion.
